links.outcome: Answer correctness of LLM with versus without RAG grounding in guidelines
links.effect: GPT-4o-mini without RAG performed significantly worse (20.0% correct, 32.9% wrong) than with RAG (57.6% correct, 15.3% wrong); RAG models ranged 56.6%-70.6% correct.
links.quote: GPT-4o-mini without RAG performed significantly worse (20.0%, 32.9% wrong).

links.outcome: Expert-graded output accuracy of guideline question answering against reference guidelines
links.effect: Best model Claude 3.5 Sonnet 70.6% correct, 10.6% wrong; other RAG models 56.6-64.7% correct with 15.3-17.6% wrong; retrieval errors caused 80% of incorrect answers.
links.quote: Claude Sonnet 3.5 achieved the highest answer correctness (70.6% correct, 10.6% wrong), followed by Llama 3.1 (64.7%, 15.3% wrong), GPT-4o-mini with RAG (57.6%, 15.3% wrong), and Mixtral (56.6%, 17.6% wrong).

unlisted_practices: Comparing retrieval strategies (BM25 vs vector embeddings) for RAG guideline question answering

screen.reason: Empirically assesses the addition of retrieval augmented generation (RAG) to an LLM baseline (GPT-4o-mini with vs. without RAG) for answering clinical guideline questions.
